newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE police seize hashish in apples.
newsitem.headline: UAE police seize hashish in apples.

text.p: Coastguards in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) have arrested 14 men trying to smuggle 150 kg (330 lb) of hashish hidden inside boxes of apples, local newspapers said on Thursday.
They said 13 seamen and a ship's captain had been arrested by the anti-narcotics squad of Abu Dhabi's coastguards as their boat entered UAE territorial waters.
No details of their nationalities were given but an interior ministry statement carried by the newspapers said the source of the contraband was "a neighbouring Asian country".
The statement said 110 people had been convicted in 61 drug-related cases in the last two years.
